title: office.scribe-ask request
description: A free-form question answered with one Standard-tier model call (the scribe ask level, default haiku@low) over a model-free SCR shortlist. Unknown keys are refused.

question.description: The question. The shortlist matches its terms lexically against tags, matter, topics and quotes.

project.description: Only entries from SCR files with this project.

session_id.description: Only entries from this session's SCR file.

limit.description: Most shortlisted entries sent to the model; 20 by default.
